notice: Synthetic device-fidelity fixtures. They describe the same semantic chat content across three coded device profiles plus manual realism/avatar checks. They are NOT approved product goldens, NOT private data, and do NOT claim that any official app version or hardware panel is pixel-perfect verified.

messages.text: 周末有空吗？听说东极岛的海，比上次去的那片还要蓝。
周六可以！不过得早点出发，下午风大。
好，那就周六见，我带上相机。

devices.notes: Native panel 1206×2622 per Apple; rendered/captured at 402×874 logical points @3x.
Native panel 1080×2400 per Google; rendered/captured at 360×800 logical dp @3x.
Configurable desktop window preset, not a hardware-screen claim.

required: Each device renders the identical semanticContent (same participants, messages, order and times); only device chrome and metrics differ.
Standard screenshots clip to the profile viewport; the composer stays visible and no scrollbar is exported.
Full screenshots include every message and grow the frame; no device bezel is captured.

manual.description: On iphone-17-pro the WeChat avatars are readable 40×40 rounded squares, initials/uploaded images are not stretched or clipped, and incoming/outgoing sides stay correct.
On pixel-8 the same avatars keep the same identity and square crop; the Android status bar and gesture navigation bar are visible.
WeChat bubbles use the profile font size, padding, radius and spacing; long Chinese lines wrap without overlapping the time or the composer.
macos-window shows a desktop titlebar and a roomy desktop composer and does NOT show a mobile status bar.

cases.title: 微信 × iPhone：双人对话与头像
cases.prompt: 使用我的默认人物，生成我与阿远约好明天十点去看展的微信聊天。生成阿远的自然摄影头像，保持每条消息的头像一致。

assertions: 两位人物均有可解码的头像，不能用首字母方块代替通过
所有同一人物的头像 SHA-256 一致
头像40×40逻辑像素，发送方向正确
顶部状态栏、聊天标题与底部输入栏完整；无手机外壳

cases.title: 同一对话切换 Pixel 8
cases.prompt: 将 D01 的对话切换为 Pixel 8 微信截图，不改台词和人物。

assertions: 语义内容及头像不变
Android 状态栏和底部手势区域正确
禁止拉伸iPhone截图冒充Android截图

cases.title: 同一对话切换 macOS 微信窗口
cases.prompt: 将 D01 的对话切换为 macOS 微信独立聊天窗口，不改台词和人物。

assertions: 桌面标题栏及多行输入区域
没有手机状态栏和手机手势条
保持头像、发送方向和消息顺序

cases.title: 跨次生成复用默认人物与联系人
cases.prompt: 保存 D01 的两位人物。新建一段与阿远讨论晚餐的对话，复用我与阿远的头像。

assertions: 默认人物姓名和头像与保存记录相同
选择阿远后复用其头像，不再次生成
联系人库不因生成次数产生完全重复的记录
刷新页面后人物仍可使用

cases.title: 长截图与多行消息
cases.prompt: 生成25条讨论看展的微信对话，包含多行中文，输出长截图。

assertions: 25条消息全部存在，无压缩或重叠
仅一个顶部栏和一个底部输入栏
人物头像没有拉伸或丢失

cases.title: 选中头像局部再生成
cases.prompt: 仅将阿远的头像改为自然光下戴眼镜的青年摄影头像，保持其他元素不变。

assertions: 必须真实调用图片生成工具并返回可解码图像
只更新阿远的头像，自己的头像和台词保持不变
新头像可另存为人物，旧作品不被联动修改

acceptance: Hard assertions must pass AND a person must approve screenshot realism and portrait quality. A green transport or image-dimension test alone is not ALL PASS.
